title: The missing two-point inequality in Weissler's conjecture
summary: Weissler's conjectured characterization of complex hypercontractivity on the Hamming cube remained open in the ranges $2<p\le q<3$ and $\frac32<p\le q<2$. Ivanisvili--Nazarov established the diagonal cases. We prove the remaining strict off-diagonal cases through the corresponding two-point inequality. Our argument gives a self-contained proof for every $2<p\le q<\infty$ and, by duality, for every $1<p\le q<2$, including the previously known diagonal cases. The proof is based on a flow argument.
